Find Stores with Inventory Imbalance
solution:
SELECT store_id
FROM inventory
GROUP BY store_id
HAVING ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN product_type = 'in' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) -
           SUM(CASE WHEN product_type = 'out' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END)) > 100;

Find Students with Study Spiral Pattern
solution:
SELECT student_id
FROM study_logs
GROUP BY student_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT subject) >= 3;

title: Find Books with Polarized Opinions
solution:
SELECT book_id
FROM reviews
GROUP BY book_id
HAVING MAX(rating) - MIN(rating) >= 4;
